findings.summary: The whole session's post-1.37.0 work sat on main UNRELEASED — the plugin cache deploys the latest TAG, so a downstream `claude plugin update` reported 1.37.0 as latest and the TEST-LOCK deadlock fix never reached the wedged repo (the committed-not-deployed gap). Cutting v1.38.0 bundles it so downstream vendored copies pick it up.
findings.disposition: Version bumped 1.37.0 -> 1.38.0 across all four identity files (plugin.json, marketplace.json, claude+codex adapter.json) + CHANGELOG; test_release_version_identity pins all four EQUAL. Every shipped item is individually covered by its own closed review record (2026-08-16-holdout-diagnose, -ambient-input-anchor-validated, -isolation-probe-validated, -holdout-process-documented, -test-lock-deadlock-recovery); this record covers the identity-file + CHANGELOG bump commit. Gate GREEN on the shipping commit; David tags v1.38.0 after CI confirms on the pushed sha (the model cannot tag).
